name: template-project
description: A template project for Hono, Vite and Cloudflare Services.

scripts.preview: $npm_execpath run set-env-staging && $npm_execpath run build && vite preview
scripts.check-staging: $npm_execpath run set-env-staging && tsc && vite build && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy-staging: $npm_execpath run set-env-staging && $npm_execpath run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: $npm_execpath run set-env-production && tsc && vite build && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy: $npm_execpath run set-env-production && $npm_execpath run build && wrangler deploy
